n 2023, Meta signed contracts with CarbonCapture and Heirloom↗ to deliver carbon removal credits
from DAC projects. When paired with geologic storage, DAC offers high carbon storage durability and a
limited physical footprint making it a potentially readily scalable and promising carbon removal pathway.
Meta also signed a contract with Charm Industrial↗, which sequesters carbon by storing pyrolyzed waste
biomass into geologic formations deep underground. Novel carbon removal technologies like these require
early adoption from companies like Meta to help scale up and bring costs down, and we will continue to
